description: Get a link to send one image, video or document from your disk (logo, screenshot, product shot, PDF) for a task to work from. Send the file with an HTTP PUT, e.g. curl -T <path> '<upload_url>'; the answer is JSON with the file_id to pass in files on start_task or reply. The link works for 15 minutes. One file_id works for any number of tasks. Up to 100 MB; compress anything larger. Upload an image or video right before the task that uses it: about 20 can wait unsent, and waiting ones also block your human uploading in the app. A large scan can take minutes to read; start_task says when it is not ready yet.

filename.description: Its name with extension, which sets how it is read.

name: upload_file
